details:
The traefik project releases a new version addressing multiple
vulnerabilities:

> - GHSA-5w68-77r2-r64c (Complete authentication bypass in the
>   \`digestAuth\` middleware)
> - GHSA-g55h-rg46-x9c5 (TLS option confusion in multi-host routers can
>   bypass mTLS for protected hosts)
> - GHSA-j994-9gqj-9hwq (Same-host Ingress TLS option conflict disables
>   client-certificate authentication)
> - GHSA-m6wx-622r-48r9 (Kubernetes Ingress service middleware bypasses
>   crossProviderNamespaces)
